# Asset Licenses / Provenance

| Asset | Source | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| All pixel art (players, field, stadium, crowd, ball) | Original — drawn in code (`js/game.js`) | MIT (this repo) | No third-party sprites |
| All sound effects & crowd audio | Original — synthesized in code (`js/audio.js`, WebAudio) | MIT (this repo) | No sampled audio |
| Fonts | System monospace (`Courier New` / browser default) | OS-provided | Not embedded |
| Team names/logos (Raptors, Comets) | Original fiction | MIT (this repo) | Not based on real teams |

**Policy:** no asset may be added from an external source without a row here documenting
creator, license, commercial-use terms, and attribution requirements. No Hoop Land,
NFL, NCAA, or real-athlete likenesses may ever be copied, traced, or recolored.
